Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:238520
Court No. - 70
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 54016 of 2023

Applicant :- Smt. Rani Devi
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Ambreesh Kumar,Sr. Advocate
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Brijesh Tiwari
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1. Heard Sri Kamal Krishna, learned Senior Advocate assisted by Sri Ambreesh Kumar, learned
counsel for the applicant, Sri Manoj Kumar, Advocate holding brief of Sri Brijesh Tiwari, learned
counsel for the informant and Sri Kunwar Tejendra Bahadur, learned Aga for the State.
2.

The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 483 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 304B IPC and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Kalyanpur, District Kanpur Nagar during pendency of the trial.

3. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant, her husband and Devar and according to the FIR marriage of the Devar of the applicant was performed with the daughter of the informant on 26.01.2023 and after marriage applicant and her family members tortured her for Rs. 5 lakhs and four wheeler.

It is further mentioned in the FIR that applicant continuously tortured the daughter of the informant and on 03.11.2023 applicant and her family members including husband of the deceased committed the murder of daughter of the informant.

sentences.text: 4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that applicant is Jethani of the deceased and on the basis false allegation of demand of dowry and torture, she has been made accused in the present matter.

5. He further submits that being Jethani of the deceased she was not having any concern with the family affairs of the deceased but unfortunately as she used to reside in separate portion of same house along with her husband, therefore, she has been made accused in the present matter along with husband of the deceased.

6. He further submits that actually husband of the deceased was in job in District Siddharth Nagar and deceased used to pressurize her husband to take her with him but as he was having some residential problem, therefore, husband of the deceased was not able to accept her proposal and only due to this reason some dispute arose between husband and wife and deceased hanged herself.
7. He further submits that post mortem report of the deceased suggests that she died due to hanging.
He further submits that applicant is a lady and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter she is in jail since 07.11.2023.

8. Per contra, learned AGA as well as learned counsel appearing on behalf of the informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that applicant is Jethani of the deceased and she was also residing in same house where deceased resided and deceased died under abnormal circumstances in her matrimonial home and there is also allegation of demand of dowry and there is specific allegation against applicant that she used to torture the deceased, therefore, considering the provisions of Section 304B IPC and Section 113B of Indian Evidence Act, applicant should not be released on bail.
9. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

10. From the record, it reflects that applicant is Jethani of the deceased and however there is specific allegation in the FIR that she used to torture the deceased but as far as allegation of demand of dowry is concerned that has also been leveled against Jeth of the deceased i.e. husband of the applicant and husband of the deceased.

11. Further, post mortem report of the deceased suggests that she died due to hanging, therefore,
argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant cannot be completely brushed aside at this stage.
12. Further, the law is settled that bail should not be dismissed either for punitive or preventive purpose.
13. Further, applicant is a lady and she is not having any criminal history and in the present matter she is in jail since 07.11.2023 i.e. about more than a month.

14. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

sentences.text: Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

16. Let the applicant - Smt. Rani Devi be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
17. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

18. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
